verified.catalyst: Boliden is buying Votorantim's 64.68% of Nexa at 0.250 new BOL shares per Nexa share, with closing expected Q1 2027. Within 30 days of closing Boliden runs a voluntary cash tender for the minority shares at 0.250 x BOL's 20-day VWAP on Nasdaq Stockholm before closing, funded by a fully committed $2bn bridge.
verified.dated_milestone: Boliden EGM votes on the in-kind share issue on 2026-11-23 (simple majority). Next: Swedish FDI clearance and the Nexa EGM that appoints the new board, then closing in Q1 2027. The cash tender starts within 30 days of closing (about Feb-Apr 2027). Mandatory tender offers for the Peruvian subsidiaries follow within 6 months of closing.
verified.instrument: NEXA common (NYSE). This is only a clean arb if hedged short BOL.ST about 0.25x and short SEK/long USD, because the tender price floats with BOL's 20d VWAP before closing and with USD/SEK.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 yes: named counterparties Boliden and Votorantim, definitive agreement signed 2026-08-27. G2 yes: fixed 0.250 ratio, a cash tender commitment within 30 days of closing, and a fully committed $2bn bridge. G3 partial: the live spread is about 9.5%, but the figure is not fixed because it moves with BOL's price and USD/SEK.
verified.edge: M. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base is NEGATIVE, about -26%. The base is about $13.39, derived from the $15.29 offer at a 14.2% premium to Nexa's 20-day average as of 2026-07-01. Today NEXA is $9.96 because BOL fell from a 727.8 SEK high to 445 SEK and the SEK weakened (USD/SEK 10.198). Remaining capture is about +9.5% gross: at spot, 445 SEK x 0.25 / 10.198 = $10.91, versus $9.96, in roughly 3-5 months to the tender (about 25-30% annualized). This is the spread, not an outright re-rate. Unhedged, the position is mostly a long-BOL/long-SEK bet. The edge is the hedged spread.
verified.primary_source: Nexa SC TO-C and 6-K (SEC EDGAR, 2026-08-27, deal terms; tender not yet commenced). Boliden EGM invitation (Boliden/Inderes release, autumn 2026, EGM 2026-11-23). FMP quotes 2026-11-20: NEXA $9.96, BOL.ST 445 SEK, USD/SEK 10.198.
verified.analysis: The deal is real, dated and unfired. The Boliden EGM is 2026-11-23, closing is targeted for Q1 2027, the minority cash tender comes within 30 days of closing, the $2bn bridge is committed, and the SEC filings say the tender has not commenced. The roughly 9.5% spread is real but it floats: the tender is priced off BOL's 20d VWAP before closing, converted to USD, so an unhedged NEXA long carries BOL and SEK beta (NEXA is down about 26% from its pre-deal base purely on BOL/FX). The wide spread also prices real risks: the tender is voluntary and Nexa stays listed on NYSE, so minorities could be stranded under a controlled, levered company (EV $3.67bn vs equity $2.0bn implies about $1.6bn net debt, our derivation). Brazilian CADE review was not confirmed, and I did not verify whether the tender carries a minimum or price-adjustment terms. A cash tender is contractual, so the numerator-provenance check is exempt. WATCH until the EGM passes and FDI clears. It is ACTIVE-able only as a hedged pair (long NEXA / short 0.25 BOL.ST / short SEK).

verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: FDA, BLA accepted with priority review) + G2 (concrete dated commitment: PDUFA 2027-03-10). G3 is weak: the binary is widely known and the approval odds are already high. The unpriced part is the equity re-rating after the stock fell back below where it traded before acceptance, not a hidden figure.
verified.edge: M. The event is real, dated and forward. Phase 3 HAELO showed an 87% cut in attacks vs placebo with no serious adverse events in the lonvo-z arm, so approval odds are roughly 85-90%. (a) Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: about 0% or negative. The stock rose on BLA acceptance in Sept 2026 and was $12.11 on 2026-11-09, but it now trades at $9.52, below its 50-day average (11.70) and 200-day average (12.89) and near its 52-week low of 7.95. The event is not harvested. (b) Remaining to the favorable-resolution value: about +35-50% (approval value around $13-14). Downside on a complete response letter (CRL) is around $5.5, roughly 1.25x cash per share. Headwinds that keep this at M: crowded HAE prophylaxis market (approved and late-stage rivals, so the commercial ramp is uncertain), the nex-z MAGNITUDE hold overhang, and an unexplained -21% move since Nov 9.

verified.analysis: The lonvo-z BLA is a clean dated binary: priority review, PDUFA 2027-03-10, no AdCom, strong Phase 3 efficacy and safety. Cash is $614.8M as of 2026-09-30 (runway into 2028, before any lonvo-z revenue) against a $1.34B market cap, so EV is about $0.72B. The capital structure has no preferred stack, only an OrbiMed senior secured term loan; the drawn amount is unverified, and a secondary source's $400M figure is unconfirmed. The upside is a probability-weighted re-rating, not a contractual payment. Gaps: I could not identify why the stock fell from $12.11 (11-09) to $9.52 (11-20) because the web search budget ran out. A new nex-z/MAGNITUDE safety read or news about a competing HAE drug would change the setup, so check that before acting. The approval is also months away and largely expected, which keeps this at WATCH rather than ACTIVE.

verified.analysis: The event is real, forward and unfired: enrollment is complete, Q1 2027 topline was reiterated on 2026-11-10, and the result is binary. Price is $7.15, market cap $626M against $413.8M cash at Q3 (2026-09-30), so EV is about $212M. Q3 net loss was $73.6M; runway is to mid-2028 including the credit facility. With no preferred stock, the common sits behind only the credit facility, so a positive readout accrues to the equity. Gaps: the drawn credit-facility balance was not verified (a 10-Q lookup was not spent), and neither was whether OPERA-01's primary endpoint covers ESR1-mutant only or all-comers. The roughly $16 success value is my own estimate, not derived from the filings. A sector-sentiment overhang (SERENA-4) is the main reason it is cheap, and also the main risk if the class read-through is negative.
